Summary: Truth is under pressure from censorship, misinformation, and the fear of speaking plainly.
BiblicalPrinciples: Truth sets free; lying lips are an abomination; speech is stewardship.
BiblicalResponse: Speak truth without fear and without cruelty; refuse to spread what you have not checked; defend others' freedom to speak even when you disagree.
Pitfalls: Confusing boldness with rudeness; sharing outrage before verifying; demanding silence from opponents.
